title: Two Stacks in Array
recognition_cue: Manage two independent LIFO boundaries in shared storage.
invariant: The first stack grows from the left, the second from the right, and their occupied ranges never overlap.

approaches.name: Contiguous sections with shifting
approaches.time: O(n) stack1 push/pop; O(1) amortized stack2 push/pop

approaches.name: Share free space between opposing tops
